recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x prior homogeneous group initiator top/middle/base x final middle/base lower-card Alt-R), against the checked-in board surface. Three-Pokemon construction and the group q1 refresh/reconstruction followed by four total group rotations are narrowly transcribed from digest-pinned source; geometry conventions and prior group states are inherited from digest-pinned fixture dependencies. Keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed, the application module is stubbed, and only the final selected-lower single=true transition is measured after the reconstructed group returns to q0.

included: forty-eight independently constructed marker-free histories, executed as separate ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case captures

local/opponent active and sole-bench histories whose top-, middle-, or base-initiated homogeneous group was refreshed at q1, reconstructed, and advanced through q0 before middle or base was selected once with single=true
digest-pinned active/bench Alt-R ingress and clicked-image-to-zone/index selection without executing the application keydown listener
the absolute q0 single=true branch advancing exactly the selected lower evolution to q1 with PokemonBreak=true while preserving every other card rotation and BREAK flag
pre/post action evidence, complete reconstruction and transition traces, history-sensitive margins, topology and links, painted/authored geometry, ten hit probes, observer ownership, and cleanup
excluded: pristine group-q0 lower-card Alt-R without a q1 refresh/reconstruction history, which is pinned by a dependent checkpoint
group q0 reached without the characterized q1 refresh, BREAK-off q0, already-BREAK lower q0, and repeated Alt-R after the measured transition
the q1-refreshed and intermediate q2/q3 phases themselves, two-wrapper synchronous refresh geometry, and group rotation or refresh after the final divergent lower-card action
raw/imported divergent states and mixed top/lower or middle/base group initiators outside the one preserved homogeneous initiator
normalizing history-authored q0 margins, lower-card rotation, or BREAK flags into canonical v2 state, commands, rendering, or UX
converted categories, non-Pokemon initiators, Energy, Trainer, Tool, markers, attachment timing/syncRotation histories, mixed dimensions, and noncanonical assets
additional bench siblings, flex shrink, overflow, active/bench movement, promotion, evolution/removal after divergence, leaveAll, undo, and replay
resize-driven board layout, explicit flip, fullscreen, alternate viewport/DPR, concealment, application/network execution, candidate parity, and production geometry
